patterns.note: Sections alternate between full-width content blocks and narrower, centered content, often with asymmetrical text and image placements.
The hero features a large, decorative serif font rendered along a curve, contrasting with clean, legible sans-serif fonts used for all other headings and body text.
The site uses a pastel background palette (off-white, light sage, light yellow) as a canvas for vibrant, multi-color illustrations and a contrasting dark green for key text and footer sections.
The header transforms from a larger, transparent bar into a compact, sticky bar with a solid background and centered logo as the user scrolls past the hero section.
Content sections are visually delineated by alternating background colors (off-white, light sage green, light yellow, dark green), creating clear visual breaks down the page.

technique_notes: The main navigation bar transitions from a larger, transparent overlay at the top of the page to a smaller, fixed header with a solid background and a more compact layout once the user scrolls past the initial hero content.
The hero section features a large, custom illustration with text that is rendered along a curved path, creating a unique and inviting visual focal point.
Content sections are visually separated by distinct, full-width background colors, providing a clear rhythm and structure to the page layout.

design_tokens.type_scale: oversized, decorative curved hero text (~4x body) with a clear hierarchy of sans-serif headings and legible body text.
design_tokens.radius: subtle for interactive elements like buttons, otherwise sharp for most content blocks.
design_tokens.spacing: airy, particularly in the hero and between major content blocks, creating a relaxed and uncrowded feel.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its whimsical, custom-illustrated hero section, which combines a unique curved text treatment with a vibrant, playful art style, immediately setting a warm and inviting tone that feels personal and handcrafted.
